findings.title: 6 ground domains detected
findings.description: Board has 6 separate ground domains: ?, ?, ?, ?, ?. Multiple ground domains require careful single-point connection to avoid ground loops and EMI.
findings.recommendation: Verify ground domains connect at a single, intentional point (typically near the ADC for analog/digital split). Ensure no signal traces cross the domain boundary.

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J-ETH-USB1
findings.description: J-ETH-USB1 (SM04B-GHS-TB) has 1 ground pin(s) for 4 signal pins. Recommended: at least 2 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J-ETH-USB1 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (55×35mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1299 MHz; (0,1) at 2042 MHz; (1,1) at 2420 MHz; (2,0) at 2599 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.

findings.recommendation: Match trace lengths to within 25 ps (4.6mm). Use length-matched serpentine routing.
